Container.Name: Blindspark
Container.Overview: Run an always-on blind relay for Pear and Holepunch peer-to-peer applications.
Container.Description: Blindspark stores and serves encrypted Hyperdrive data that the relay can verify but cannot read. It helps peer-to-peer applications stay reachable while their publishers and users are offline. Persistent identity, configuration, and seeded data live in the appdata directory.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: hiverelay pear holepunch p2p relay hypercore
Container.Requires: A unique management API key of at least 32 characters. Keep the dashboard on a trusted network.

Config.Name: Dashboard Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Blindspark dashboard and management API.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent identity, configuration, Hypercores, and seeded content.

Config.Name: Management API Key
Config.Description: Unique secret of at least 32 characters used by the dashboard and management API.

Config.Name: Home
Config.Description: Keep HiveRelay configuration with its persistent data.

Config.Name: Incoming Request Mode
Config.Description: review, open, allowlist, or closed. Review is the safe home-server default.

Config.Name: Storage Cap
Config.Description: Maximum storage made available to HiveRelay on first boot.

Config.Name: Dashboard Authentication
Config.Description: Embed the management token so dashboard controls can authenticate. Use only on a trusted LAN or behind an authenticating proxy.

Config.Name: Holesail Transport
Config.Description: Enable optional Holesail transport for additional NAT traversal.
